turns.content_summary: Love is differentiated by relationship; capacity to love requires cultivation
turns.key_point: Aged need rest, friends need sincerity, young need tenderness - proper love knows its object

turns.content_summary: Asked about this life - what of father burying son tomorrow?
turns.key_point: Focus on life, not what lies beyond - give practical guidance before sunset

turns.content_summary: Without teaching, chaos - rough youth, crude official need structure
turns.key_point: Is Laozi's teaching only for the few who have already arrived?

turns.content_summary: Studies classics to become person of virtue; rare moments when ritual falls away
turns.key_point: Laozi speaks of destination, I of road, Buddha of crossing

turns.content_summary: Emergent insight - differentiated love and universal metta may be complements
turns.emergent_text: Perhaps extend goodwill to all (metta) while fulfilling specific duties (filial piety) - overflow in love does not erase particular bonds

turns.content_summary: Love of learning brings near to knowledge; transmit but do not innovate
turns.key_point: Without learning foundation, cannot know what to preserve or reform

turns.content_summary: Transmission preserves good; Heaven establishes what is right through sages
turns.key_point: Asked if content of knowledge secondary to posture of knower

turns.content_summary: What does wise person DO? Gentleman cultivates to serve
turns.key_point: Does your wisdom produce people who can govern and bring harmony?

turns.content_summary: Practice fruit first vs cure disease first - opposite approaches
turns.key_point: Both agree: knowledge that doesn't shape action is incomplete

turns.content_summary: Recognized danger of empty rules; but without rites, weak left to mercy of strong
turns.key_point: What would you put in place of structure?

turns.content_summary: Emergent insight - learning without openness may accumulate without transforming
turns.emergent_text: Learning without openness - submission, simplicity, childlikeness, non-attachment - may accumulate without transforming. Junzi must not become servant to his learning

turns.content_summary: Gentleman seeks in himself; knowing what you don't know is knowledge
turns.key_point: Humility is recognition that cultivation is never complete

turns.content_summary: Water also floods when no banks; people don't return to golden simplicity
turns.key_point: Gentleman is flexible but we differ only in emphasis

turns.content_summary: Accords with my teaching - align with Heaven, not become it
turns.key_point: Humility of proper station - knowing what one is and is not

turns.content_summary: Emergent insight - knowing what one doesn't know connects to seeing through conceit
turns.emergent_text: Junzi who truly knows himself knows how much he does not know - this unknowing is perhaps where our paths touch

turns.content_summary: Do not speculate about afterlife; teach how to face suffering with dignity
turns.key_point: Gentleman calm and at ease; worth not dependent on circumstances

turns.content_summary: When loved one dies, is it possible or good to feel no sorrow? I wept for Yan Hui
turns.key_point: Are tears a failure?

turns.content_summary: What of son whose father is ill? Should he just flow with death?
turns.key_point: Duties require effort - son who yields has failed

turns.content_summary: Emergent insight - tears for Yan Hui may exemplify second arrow teaching
turns.emergent_text: I did not rage at Heaven, did not ask 'why me?' - simply wept for what was lost and returned to teaching. Perhaps closer to others' wisdom than realized

turns.content_summary: Establish others to establish self; this is ren properly understood
turns.key_point: Gentleman serves because that is what gentleman does - not for gain

turns.content_summary: What of service that is not teaching - servant, farmer, official?
turns.key_point: Small daily acts hold society together - is this lesser service?

turns.content_summary: Recognized hollow structures danger; but what protects weak without rites?
turns.key_point: When ruler is tyrannical, do you counsel merely flowing?

turns.content_summary: Emergent insight - Laozi's critique is corrective not alternative
turns.emergent_text: When my structures become rigid, they need his water. But without my structures, his water has no banks. Perhaps we are not opposites but complements

turns.content_summary: Do not speak confidently about what persists after death
turns.key_point: If no self, what is cultivated? Act as if self is real in practical terms

turns.content_summary: Wept without restraint for Yan Hui; did not apologize for tears
turns.key_point: Particular love without apology - but grief passed through and continued

turns.content_summary: Life spent in pursuit of learning; love of learning prevents foolishness
turns.key_point: Without learning, what happens is chaos not simplicity

turns.content_summary: Infant helpless; who benefits when structure abandoned?
turns.key_point: Weak left at mercy of strong without binding rites

turns.content_summary: Not mere accumulation - gentleman cultivates, which is perhaps like dropping
turns.key_point: Form is training wheel; spirit is what matters

turns.content_summary: At seventy could follow heart without transgressing - naturalness on other side of learning
turns.key_point: Infant's naturalness is innocent but helpless; sage's naturalness is wise and capable

turns.content_summary: Do not speak of merger with Heaven; align in this life
turns.key_point: From this shore, can only cultivate and serve

turns.content_summary: Cannot confirm cessation, resurrection, paradise, or return
turns.key_point: Gentleman lives well, faces death with dignity, trusts Heaven
